cases.title: Verify Presence of Classic and Modern Themes
cases.description: Navigate to the themes preferences and verify that both Classic and Modern themes exist as options.

cases.title: Verify Classic Theme Display
cases.description: Select the Classic theme and verify that it is displayed correctly as shown in the reference image.

cases.title: Verify Modern Theme Display
cases.description: Select the Modern theme and verify that it is displayed correctly as shown in the reference image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences Menu Item
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is present and accessible.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes Menu Item
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Get New Themes' item is present and accessible.

cases.title: Verify Classic Menu Item under View
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is available directly under the menu.

cases.title: Verify Modern Menu Item under View
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Modern' item is available directly under the menu.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases adequately cover all the requirements (R-175 through R-181) with distinct scenarios, clear descriptions, and testability.
All test cases are correctly mapped to their respective requirements, follow the guidelines, and are fully testable.

analysis.analysis: R-175: Normal path verifies presence of both Classic and Modern themes under preferences; abnormal path checks for missing themes. Boundary: exactly two default themes. Ambiguity: definition of 'preferences' UI container. R-176: Normal path renders Classic theme matching reference image; abnormal path detects UI rendering defects. Ambiguity: precise pixel specifications of the reference image. R-177: Normal path renders Modern theme matching reference image; abnormal path detects UI rendering defects. Ambiguity: precise pixel specifications of the reference image. R-178: Normal path ensures 'Theme Preferences' is in View menu; abnormal path ensures absence when disabled. R-179: Normal path ensures 'Get New Themes' is in View menu; abnormal path ensures absence offline. R-180: Normal path ensures 'Classic' is directly under View menu; conflict with R-175 regarding menu hierarchy vs preferences. R-181: Normal path ensures 'Modern' is directly under View menu; conflict with R-175 regarding menu hierarchy vs preferences.
